name: Himemiya Nagisa
source:
Her mother died of an illness when she was young so she was raised by her father, most of the time overseas.
She's a bright optimistic girl who supports her father.
As a graduation present she was given a fancy boat trip to where her father is waiting, but she fell overboard and ended up washing ashore at the princes vacation villa.
